question: Find the full names of members who either generated income over $40 or incurred an expense under $50, and who are from Illinois.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T1."XCL_035", T1."XCL_036"
FROM member AS T1
INNER JOIN zip_code AS T2 ON T1."XCL_041" = T2."XCL_043"
WHERE T2."XCL_047" = 'Illinois'
  AND (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM income AS T3
      WHERE T3."XCL_029" = T1."XCL_034"
        AND T3."XCL_026" > 40
    )
    OR
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM expense AS T4
      WHERE T4."XCL_022" = T1."XCL_034"
        AND T4."XCL_020" < 50
    )
  )
